title: Contextual Information Policy Optimization for Search Agents
title_zh: 面向搜索智能体的上下文信息策略优化
abstract_en: Search agents extend large language models beyond static parametric memory by enabling them to acquire and use external evidence during multi-step reasoning. For knowledge-intensive tasks involving complex or evolving information, their reliability depends not only on retrieving relevant evidence but also on using it to guide subsequent reasoning. However, existing methods primarily reward final-answer correctness or intermediate progress, without directly assessing whether post-retrieval actions are grounded in the retrieved evidence. This misalignment encourages prior-driven reasoning: agents form conclusions based on internal knowledge and use retrieval mainly to confirm them, resulting in confirmation bias and inefficient evidence use. To address this issue, we propose Contextual Information Policy Optimization (CIPO), an evidence-oriented reinforcement learning framework that explicitly aligns policy optimization with external evidence use. CIPO assigns dense, turn-level credit to reasoning actions influenced by retrieved information, while combining this evidence-use signal with a global outcome reward to preserve answer correctness. With this manner, CIPO discourages evidence-detached guesses and promotes reasoning trajectories in which retrieved facts can guide or revise subsequent reasoning. Importantly, CIPO requires neither human process annotations nor an additional reward model. Extensive experiments on seven in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks show that CIPO reduces the prevalence of prior-driven reasoning and achieves excellent performance on most tasks.
abstract_zh: 本文关注 Search Agents 在多步推理中如何有效利用外部检索证据。现有方法通常只奖励最终答案正确性或中间进展，缺少对“检索后动作是否真正基于证据”的直接约束，容易导致模型依赖内部先验先得出结论，再用检索结果进行确认，从而产生确认偏差与低效证据使用。为此，论文提出 Contextual Information Policy Optimization（CIPO），一种面向证据使用的强化学习框架。CIPO 在每个推理轮次为受检索信息影响的动作分配稠密信用，同时结合全局结果奖励以保持最终答案准确性。该方法鼓励智能体让检索事实指导或修正后续推理，减少脱离证据的猜测，并且无需人工过程标注或额外奖励模型。作者在 7 个域内与域外基准上实验，表明 CIPO 能降低先验驱动推理比例，并在多数任务上取得优秀表现。
key_points_zh: 问题动机：现有 Search Agents 训练目标多关注最终正确性，未显式评估检索后推理是否基于外部证据，容易出现 prior-driven reasoning（先验驱动推理）和 confirmation bias（确认偏差）。
核心方法：提出 Contextual Information Policy Optimization（CIPO），在强化学习中加入证据使用导向的稠密、轮次级信用分配，奖励被检索信息实际影响的推理动作。
训练优势：CIPO 将局部证据使用信号与全局答案奖励结合，既鼓励依据证据修正推理轨迹，也避免牺牲最终答案正确性。
标注成本：该框架不需要人工过程标注，也不依赖额外 reward model，降低了搜索智能体训练的工程与数据成本。
实验结果：在 7 个域内和域外 benchmark 上，CIPO 减少先验驱动推理，并在大多数任务上取得优良性能。

llm_assessment.comment: Strongly in-scope search-agent RL work that optimizes evidence-grounded reasoning from retrieved information.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇高度契合方向的搜索智能体强化学习论文，优化了基于检索证据的推理过程。
